Clinical Research Coordinator Linked in BlueSky Facebook Kiley McKenna Baker is a Clinical Research Coordinator at the Wyss Institute at Harvard University. She graduated with degrees in Athletic Training and Dance Studies from Dean College in 2017, and earned an M.Sc. in Dance Science and Education from the University of Edinburgh in 2019.
